title: Anna's Day
text:
Anna wakes up at seven o'clock. She brushes her teeth and eats breakfast. She drinks a cup of tea. Then she goes to school.

After school, Anna does her homework. She plays with her dog in the park. At eight o'clock, she has dinner with her family. She goes to bed at nine.

questions.text: What time does Anna wake up?
What time does Anna have dinner?
How does Anna probably feel about her dog?
Why does Anna go to bed at nine?
options: She needs rest for the next day
She is going on a trip

paragraph_translations: Anna se despierta a las siete en punto. Se cepilla los dientes y desayuna. Bebe una taza de té. Luego va a la escuela.
Después de la escuela, Anna hace su tarea. Juega con su perro en el parque. A las ocho en punto, cena con su familia. Se acuesta a las nueve.
